class.name: LRTGeometryBinding3D
class.brief_description: Binds a mesh instance to its own object-space Color SDF resource.
class.description: Place this node directly under a [MeshInstance3D]. The parent mesh and its effective materials define the bake; the binding's own transform is ignored. The parent must use Dynamic GI mode to contribute through its Color SDF. Different material instances require separate baked resources. Select this node and use [b]Bake LRT Color SDF[/b] in the 3D toolbar, or call [method bake]. The bake includes two sample cells of padding and supports closed, consistently oriented triangle meshes with opaque UV-mapped or triplanar [StandardMaterial3D] or [ORMMaterial3D] materials, including material overrides, vertex colors, metallic diffuse reduction, UV1/UV2 detail albedo with a UV1 mask (Mix, Add, Subtract or Multiply), and fixed emission. UV1 and UV2 support local and world triplanar projections, including blend sharpness, scale and offset. Triplanar projection requires finite nonzero vertex normals, but does not require UV coordinates. Its blend weights are computed per vertex and interpolated, like the engine material shader. Detail normal maps do not change the baked diffuse color. Open, non-manifold, skinned or deformed meshes and unsupported material features fail explicitly without replacing the previous bake. When LRT is enabled, this binding registers its parent Dynamic GI instance with the CPU geometry scheduler. Each volume in the same [World3D] collects intersecting bindings and rebuilds affected trunks when the parent moves, changes GI mode or visibility, or the baked resource changes. Removing the binding removes its contribution. Its own transform is ignored at runtime as well as during baking. [b]Development status:[/b] CPU geometry composition, GPU upload/history reset, direct-light/shadow and sky injection, A/L propagation and Forward+ direct Probe surface sampling are available. Disable rendering/lrt/screen_gather_enabled to select this rendering path. Screen Gather and nested-volume boundary inputs are not implemented yet. ShaderMaterial, transparency, refraction and extra material passes are not supported.

method.name: bake
method.description: Bakes the parent instance in object space and saves the result to a binary [code].res[/code] resource. Assigns [member bake_data] only after a successful save. Returns [constant OK] on success, [constant ERR_SKIP] when canceled, or an error code. LRT builds the engine triangle BVH without vertex snapping and uses double-precision triangle predicates to retain thin imported faces. The binding transform does not affect the bake. The parent world transform affects only world-triplanar material sampling, which is frozen at bake time.

method.name: get_geometry_instance
method.description: Returns the parent mesh instance, or null when this binding is not a direct child of a MeshInstance3D.

members.member: Object-space geometry cache for this instance. Mesh or material edits require rebaking. Moving the instance preserves the baked colors, including world-triplanar colors; rebake if those colors need to reflect the new world position.
Sample count along the longest Color SDF axis. Other axes are proportional. Includes two cells of padding at each end; must be at least 6.
